source_law.text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: A pedestrian shall not suddenly leave a curb or other place of safety and walk or run into the path of a vehicle which is so close that it is impossible for the driver to yield.

witness_branches: Leaving a curb into a vehicle path.

requirement_dispositions.branch: Leaving a curb into a vehicle path.
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Two 240-frame synthetic source cases have measured conditional stopping margins, six malformed-source negatives, independent source audit, pinned measurement contracts, two retained synthetic saved positives and six saved negatives, and eight unselected Native construction plans with CPU preflights, exact offline and v1 positive/negative package compatibility plus independent audits. Actual driver capability, suddenness, Native capture, strict v2 recipe, statutory exceptions and legal outcome remain unverified.
This statutory alternative or exception needs a separate compatible controlled case or explicit physical-unsupported disposition; current frozen-cell feasibility is unproven.
